description: OHLCV bars for 74 crypto pairs (BTC-USD since 2013, ETH-USD since 2016, SOL-USD, XRP-USD, DOGE-USD, TON-USD, SUI-USD, HYPE-USD, BTC-EUR, ETH-BTC and more). interval: 1min, 5min, 1hour or 1day (default). Clipped to as_of. Free keys get daily bars for the last 12 months.

as_of.description: Point-in-time cutoff (YYYY-MM-DD). Nothing dated after this is returned, preventing look-ahead bias. Defaults to today (UTC).
